speaker: alse_pinder
text: He is exactly where I said. Third tread. If you wake him he will swear in cat, and she will hear it through the floor.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see him. I am stepping wide. The cloak is the only thing I came up for.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The latch stuck on the way up. It does that in the damp. I am not asking her to have it mended for a Wednesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. It knows my hand. A wet week is not a reason to pay a man for a latch that fails only when I am in a hurry.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I can hear the pair of you conspiring with a door. Come down. The close is light enough, and you are eating the hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Coming. The cat is innocent. The latch is old. I am the one who is late if I stay to plead for either.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your collar is turned under. Hold still. There. You look like a man going to paper, which is all she asked of the cloak.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Paper, then. If I am not back when the loaf is cut, the broth is still mine, and the crust is still unproved.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not prove it without you. Go. She has her hand on the street door already, and a hand of hers on a door is a bell.
